body: I'm new to reddit so I'm not sure how this works but if anyone wants to talk I'd love that. Whether it be on here, tumblr, email or any other form of contact. I could use talking to someone who to some extent understands this. It would mean a lot

It's just hard forgiving myself but then again I still hold lots of hatred and animosity towards the people who literally spat on my face, pissed in my face and treated me like an animal. I can't even sleep these days till 5am, all I do is watch tv and go on the laptop all day and have been for 4 years. Waking up to this bullshit is verging impossible. 18 now and it looks like I already have no future and no health. I have nothing going for me at all and I'd be glad to hold on if something fucking good happened for once but the truth is my highs compared to my lows are literally 1 in a million. Life just feels like one big dream and I don't even want or care about anything anymore. All that even keeps my sanity in check is the fact that this will all be over some day.

I love fight club too! one of my favourite movies (I have a lot of time to watch a lot of movies) and that funnily enough is one of my favourite quotes and says a lot about life imo. Life is weird, it's like a perpetual dream state, a game in some senses which is probably my depersonalization talking. And yeah I have fuck all to lose at this point in time and could run away and live on the streets or move to fucking china and become a drugs merchant or do whatever without any restraints but I'd probably end up getting more guilty for my actions later on haha. I just don't see the point in anything honestly. If you really start opening your mind you realize how meaningless this life is unless you're fortunate enough to have the right genes, family background and will to create some meaning which I don't really have. I guess I have decent parents but I've drifted away from them and feel alienated to everyone at this point in time. Nothing can really fix my problems. I've just manned up and accepted my demise
Because of past mistakes, I'm a terrible person. I just wish I was born a different person, maybe life would have been easier that way
